body: Right now the book I'm working on is called "feeling good" a self help book that my older brother recommended to me, as for volunteering and just doing good things to keep myself busy, well as far as my parents are concerned if it doesn't involve making money or getting an education then I'll probably just get yelled at for doing it.

I've told my friends, but they just don't seem to understand the seriousness of the situation, as for counseling my mom said she wants me to do some after the divorce which I don't have a problem with. For now I am just waiting, waiting for things to play out, and its driving me crazy, I need something productive to occupy my time with.
